name: Dining chair, Vitra Eames DSR

clearance.note: Room behind the chair to pull it out from the table and sit down (the seat faces the table)

notes: Vitra Eames Plastic Side Chair RE DSR (design Charles & Ray Eames, 1950): shell in deep black, Eiffel wire base powder-coated basic dark. W 46.5 × D 55 × H 83 cm, seat height 43 cm, as listed by Vitra dealers (AmbienteDirect, Innes). model.glb is generated by `npx tsx tools/models/dining-chair-eames-dsr.ts` from its own geometry, to exactly these dimensions: the one-piece moulded shell (a dished seat with a waterfall front edge that flows into a back wrapping around the sitter and leaning back about 14°, narrower at the waist, with a rolled rim) on the Eiffel wire base. The collision parts follow the seat, the curved backrest and the base, so the seat slides under a table top. The clearance zone is the room behind the chair to pull it out from a table.
